mentions.name: Canine
mentions.description: A free, open source platform-as-a-service alternative to Heroku, Render, and Fly.io built on top of Kubernetes. It supports deployments of your own apps as well as 15k+ other packages such as Postgres, Airbyte, and Dagster via Helm charts.
mentions.problem: PaaS providers charge massive markups while the author missed the simplicity and convenience of a managed platform.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a Heroku / Render / Flyio alternative thats free, open source, built on top of Kubernetes.

Supports deployments of your own apps as well as 15k+ other packages (postgres, airbyte, dagster, etc) via helm charts.
